verdict_reason: The Latin-name-only chip label matches the prototype (commodity-search.js:422 chipLabel: species.label) and the updated spec, and is pinned by a unit test whose rows carry common names, but the change leaves services.md claiming the selected panel is asserted against speciesLabel.

todos.issue: Switching the selected-panel label from speciesLabel(row) to row.speciesLatinName (line 11) makes src/server/app/sets/live-animals/docs/services.md:110-113 untrue: it still says the ins-tests stack test asserts 'the selected panel against speciesLabel(commodityLines.cattle)' (commodities.spec.ts:69 and :109), but ins-tests PR 96 now names the panel's Remove buttons by species.latinName and drops the speciesLabel panel assertions.
todos.fix: Must: services.md describes what pins the fixture's species labels as the suites now do it, with no claim that the selected panel is checked against speciesLabel. One way: limit the sentence to the species checkbox accessible names (and re-check the cited commodities.spec.ts line numbers), or say the selected panel is checked by Latin name alone.
